Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:
Ok, esoteric question:

Ian Forestal Monomancies his prey's Claven (4 cap, with 4 blood on him),
and drops 5 Weather Controls before range. Can Claven end combat via
Monomancy text, or is he already torporized? (assume no nutty stuff like
Blood Tears being burned) Does he take the damage even if he does?
What if Ian plays 4 of them, and Claven DOES end combat? Can Ian Taste
of Vitae the damage?

--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Pat Ricochet wrote:
>
> Ok, esoteric question:
>
> Ian Forestal Monomancies his prey's Claven (4 cap, with 4 blood on him),
> and drops 5 Weather Controls before range. Can Claven end combat via
> Monomancy text, or is he already torporized? (assume no nutty stuff like
> Blood Tears being burned) Does he take the damage even if he does?

Torporized.

> What if Ian plays 4 of them, and Claven DOES end combat? Can Ian Taste
> of Vitae the damage?

No. Taste is playable only after strike resolution, by card text.
